title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 378X (Secretary of Producer Company)

content.overview: Every Producer Company having an average annual turnover exceeding five crore rupees, or such other amount as may be prescribed, in each of three consecutive financial years shall have a whole-time secretary. No individual shall be appointed as whole-time secretary unless he possesses membership of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India. Failure to comply attracts a penalty of one hundred rupees for every day of default, subject to a maximum of one lakh rupees. No penalty shall be imposed if it is shown that all reasonable efforts to comply were taken or that the financial position of the Company made engagement of a whole-time secretary beyond its capacity.
content.glance: Whole-time ICSI member secretary required when average annual turnover exceeds ₹5 crore (or prescribed amount) in each of three consecutive years; daily penalty up to ₹1 lakh with reasonable-efforts and capacity defences.
content.study: Section 378X imposes a whole-time company-secretary requirement on Producer Companies that cross the turnover threshold for three consecutive financial years. The secretary must be a member of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India. The penalty for default is daily but capped, and two statutory defences (reasonable efforts and financial incapacity) are available.

sections.heading: Rule
sections.body: A Producer Company with average annual turnover above ₹5 crore (or the prescribed amount) in each of three consecutive financial years must have a whole-time ICSI member as secretary; default attracts a capped daily penalty subject to the stated defences.

examples.title: Illustration — s. 378X
examples.body: A Producer Company whose average annual turnover exceeds ₹5 crore in each of three consecutive years must appoint a whole-time ICSI member as secretary under s. 378X.

hypotheticals.question: What is the core effect of s. 378X?
hypotheticals.analysis: It requires a whole-time ICSI secretary once the three-year turnover threshold is crossed, with a capped daily penalty and two statutory defences.

misconceptions.trap: Assuming every Producer Company must have a whole-time secretary.
misconceptions.correction: The requirement applies only when average annual turnover exceeds the threshold in each of three consecutive financial years.

questionsAndAnswers.question: How should s. 378X be analysed?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: I. Check the three-year turnover threshold. II. Confirm ICSI membership of the secretary. III. Apply penalty and defences if in default.
